detail_text: Specifically, A) User privileges assigned within the manufacturing equipment used for products intended for the US market are not appropriate for the job functions being performed nor are they adequately defined. For example, 1. The software PC VISUAL for| machine8491 has the three privilege groups “Operator”, “Supervisor”, and “Admin” defined. Quality Assurance personnel are assigned “Admin” privileges within the system, which includes all the abilities of the operator and supervisor roles for operating the equipment, and additionally includes the ability to perform additional functions, including but not limited to modifying the date and time, creating and modifying users, and deleting batches. 2. According to the equipment privilege details document where the user privileges are defined for Factory Talk View Studio formms 043, the user groups established within the system are “Operator”, “Supervisor”, “Admin”, and “Maintenance”. However, upon further review of the audit trail related to the system and the user role review documentation, additional groups including “Default”, “Administrators”, and “Engineer” were identified and not defined within the user privilege document. Furthermore, quality assurance personnel are assigned administrative privileges within the system, which includes operator and supervisor abilities and additional privileges to change system security and machine settings. B) User access for equipment used in the manufacturing of drug products intended for the US market is not adequately reviewed to ensure proper and approved access to the system is maintained. For example, 1. The software Factory Talk View Studio used for8 o43 allows the assignment of more than one privilege within the system. During review of the user access to the system, (JAP) observed a quality assurance user having separate “Admin” and “Administrators” privileges within the system. There is no review requirement to ensure that each user is only assigned one user privilege related to their job function. 2. During the review of users within the software PC VISUAL fol [redacted] equipment[4 491, I (JAP) observed a quality assurance user having two administrator user accounts which were interchangeably used within the system. There is no review requirement to ensure that each user is assigned only one login account per system.
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, A) US 시장용 제품에 사용되는 제조 설비에 부여된 사용자 권한이 수행하는 직무에 적절하지 않고 적절하게 정의되어 있지도 않다. 예를 들어, 1. | machine8491용 소프트웨어 PC VISUAL에는 "Operator", "Supervisor", "Admin" 세 개의 권한 그룹이 정의되어 있다. 품질 보증 인원에게 시스템 내 "Admin" 권한이 부여되어 있는데, 이는 설비를 운전하기 위한 운전원 및 감독자 역할의 모든 기능을 포함하며 날짜와 시간 수정, 사용자 생성 및 수정, 배치 삭제를 포함한 추가 기능을 수행할 수 있는 권한까지 포함하며 이에 국한되지 않는다. 2. formms 043용 Factory Talk View Studio의 사용자 권한이 정의된 설비 권한 상세 문서에 따르면 시스템에 설정된 사용자 그룹은 "Operator", "Supervisor", "Admin", "Maintenance"이다. 그러나 시스템 관련 감사 추적과 사용자 역할 검토 문서를 추가로 검토한 결과, "Default", "Administrators", "Engineer"를 포함한 추가 그룹이 확인되었으나 사용자 권한 문서에 정의되어 있지 않았다. 또한 품질 보증 인원에게 시스템 내 관리자 권한이 부여되어 있는데, 이는 운전원 및 감독자 기능과 시스템 보안 및 기계 설정을 변경할 수 있는 추가 권한을 포함한다.
